It was the final round of the National Under-15 Championship 2026 at Hyderabad. 10-year-old Divith Reddy Adulla was up against Shaunak Badole from Maharashtra. This game was the one which ended up deciding the champion of the tournament! Watch this exciting game in full with the commentary of IM Sagar Shah.
